pages.title: Gadgets
pages.text: $(bold)The Supplementaries machinery: relayers, clock and cog blocks, turntables, the safe and its key, crystal displays, spring launchers, illuminators and spikes. Needs Redstone as well.$(br2)$(thing)Gilded Age$(n), ring 5.$(br)$(thing)24 Focal Shards$(n).$(br)After Lighting and Redstone.
